items.Sentence: Up to 8 of the 16 filters can be used...
Filter backwash water is sent to a backwash equalization basin for storage
The treated backwash water is pumped to chlorine contact tanks for disinfection
an appropriate amount of sodium bisulfite is added to neutralize the hypochlorite
The channel provides additional stabilization of the treated effluent, backup aeration if low dissolved oxygen levels are detected
The settled solids from the backwash water are pumped back to primary treatment
Sludge from primary and secondary clarification operations
The process consists of primary sludge screening
dissolved air flotation (DAF) thickening of primary and secondary sludges
processed using Temperature Phased Anaerobic Digestion (TPAD) with thermophilic and mesophilic anaerobic digesters
Digested sludge then undergoes either lagoon stabilization and dewatering using open air drying beds
This project will build a new digested sludge dewatering facility, including... centrifuges... and polymer storage and dosing equipment is underway
Dewatered biosolids are used as alternative daily cover at a landfill, land applied as a soil amendment
